questions.question: OP-01/O72 (D97's reach): D97 rewrites "D59's check", but the text D59 wrote lives in D12's and D38's checks: "a whole read's or an open's waiting is at most the attempt limit times the bound plus the backoff", against D97's "No figure bounds a whole read's, an open's or a stream's total waiting"; neither D12 nor D38 names D97. Scenario: OP-01's spec flow reads D38's check and writes a total bound. What is amended?

options.label: D12, D38 read as D97 (Recommended)
options.description: D97's sentence becomes D12's and D38's checks' text (D59's Decision reads as D97), both gain Amended by D97. One reading, no total figure anywhere. Source: D97, axes.md amendment form.

options.label: As is
options.description: D59's Amended-by line points to D97; a reader of D12 or D38 must follow D59 to find the bound withdrawn. Two texts disagree until the spec flow.

questions.question: OP-01/O72 (D81's reach): D81 carries its Overlapping-mutation exception into D10, D20, D24 and O8, but not D58's "A cancelled whole read or open hands out nothing and changes nothing", D60's "a cancelled call leaves no effect (D20)", nor the reasons of D10 and D24. Scenario: on Local under Windows a cancelled open made an overlapping O2 replace fail. Which texts carry the exception?

options.label: Decisions and reasons (Recommended)
options.description: D58's sentence and D60's cancellation row gain "except as D81 states"; D10's and D24's reasons read "what every backend holds, D81's declared deviation aside" and "as if issued alone, D81's exception aside". Every text a check reads then holds. Source: D81, D43's Overlapping mutation row.

options.label: Decisions only
options.description: D58 and D60 gain the exception; D10's and D24's reasons stay as asked, as a reason records why the option was taken, not the current rule.

options.label: As is
options.description: D81's Amends list stands; D58 and D60 read as D20 does through its citation. A reader of D58 alone misses the exception.

questions.question: OP-01/O72 (D47's reason): D47's reason reads "a tier change keeps the ETag, not run", while D84 (and D119 on S3) has a tier move fail changed where D62's deviation is declared. Scenario: a reader of D47 concludes a tier move never fails changed on S3. What does D47's reason say?

options.label: Qualify by D84 (Recommended)
options.description: D47's reason reads: "the content did not change, so changed would send the caller to re-read an item that will fail not readable; where D62's deviation is declared (Azure, S3 by D119), a tier move by copy may fail changed instead (D84)". The ETag claim withdrawn. Source: D84, D119.

options.label: As is
options.description: D47's reason stays as asked; D84's Amended-by link on D47 is the reader's pointer to the narrower rule.

OP-01 end check (D100's list): D126 adds readinto1 and readlines to D93's data-read list, but D100's Decision enumerates that list again (read, read1, readinto, readline, line iteration, chunks) without them. Scenario: a reader of D100 takes its enumeration as complete. What does D100 say?

options.label: Cite only (Recommended)
options.description: D100's Decision reads: D18's first column reads "a data read (D93's list)", enumerated in D93 only; its own enumeration dropped. One list, D127's rule. Source: D100's reason, D127.

options.label: Enumerate the eight
options.description: D100's enumeration gains readinto1 and readlines. Two lists again, the drift D100 was meant to stop.

questions.question: OP-01 end check (D18's Exhausted cell): D70 has it read "b'', 0 for readinto"; D126's readinto1 returns 0 and readlines an empty list at the end, which the cell names neither of. Scenario: a stream is Exhausted; the caller calls readinto1(buf) and readlines(). What does the cell say?

options.label: Name each (Recommended)
options.description: D18's Exhausted cell reads: b'', 0 for readinto and readinto1, [] for readlines, an empty iteration for lines and chunks. Every data read has its end value in one cell. Source: io.BufferedIOBase, D70, D126.

options.label: By rule
options.description: The cell reads: each data read's end value as its own decision states it (D6, D7, D70, D126). Shorter, but a reader must open four decisions.

questions.question: OP-01 end check (D40's bound): D71 has D40's bound "cover every read but readline() without a limit and line iteration", while D126 moves readlines() without a positive hint into NP9. Scenario: a caller calls readlines() over 10 GB with no newline and expects D40's bound. What does D40's exclusion say?

options.label: Exclude NP9's scope (Recommended)
options.description: D40's bound covers every read but those in NP9's scope: readline with a negative limit, readlines without a positive hint, and line iteration (D126). One list, NP9's, so D40 cannot drift from it. Source: D71, D126.

options.label: Add readlines
options.description: D40's sentence gains readlines() without a positive hint beside readline and line iteration, a second copy of NP9's scope.
